The last 15 minutes show $1,163 SOL bought against $1,099 sold, with net flow of only +64 SOL and 1,938 sellers against 2,867 buyers: heavy two-way churn, not accumulation. The coin is already 28% off its 30-minute high after a +294% run, and early sellers outnumber buyers 0.79:1 in the first two minutes after graduation.

Insider risk is real too. The curve shows a 47% bundle share, with 421 buyers but only 6.5% top-3 concentration, which suggests bundled wallets that may be distributing into retail. A launch bot was present.

Fees matter at this size. A $20 ticket with a 1.4-5.1% round trip needs a sustained move just to break even, and a 200 SOL pool means a sell can move price against us. With a 28% drawdown already in place and the base rate for these entries around -20%, the expected outcome is negative. Skip.
